sources.snippet: Pre-converted weights: jugaadsrl/GLiNER2-Guardrails-PII-Multi-onnx. The engine runs any GLiNER2 span export — gliner2-multi-v1, gliner2-base-v1, your own fine-tune. For GLiNER2.5 boundary checkpoints use gliner25-rs: the two architectures share nothing but the encoder and the prompt format.
